Usage:
  runic-translations init --directory <directory> --catalog <id> --default-locale <tag> --namespace <namespace> --class <name> [init-options]
  runic-translations validate --catalog <file> --documents <path-or-glob...>
  runic-translations generate --catalog <file> --documents <path-or-glob...> --output <directory> [emit-switches]
  runic-translations verify --catalog <file> --documents <path-or-glob...> --output <directory> [emit-switches]
  runic-translations schema --output <directory>
  runic-translations import --source <locale>=<file>... --catalog <id> --default-locale <tag> --namespace <namespace> --class <name> --output <directory> [--format auto|json|inlang] [--dry-run] [--allow-partial]
  runic-translations analyze --catalog <file> --documents <path-or-glob...> [--sources <path-or-glob...>] [analysis-options]

Arguments may be read from a UTF-8 response file with @<file>.
Init options: --locale <tag>[:<fallback>] (repeatable) --layer <name> --no-esm --no-starter --vscode.
Emit switches: --emit-csharp --emit-json --emit-typescript --emit-template-manifest --emit-esm --emit-cpp.
Analysis options: --format text|json --fail-on-findings --unsafe-ignore-dynamic --artifact-fingerprint <sha256:...> --artifact-path <path>.
With no emit switches, generate and verify use all output groups.
Exit codes: 0 success; 1 validation or verification diagnostics; 2 invocation or operational failure.
